Messages.Author: Tomas
Messages.Body:
Minion A plays Eagle's Sight at SUP to be allowed to block an action and succesfully does so. The acting minion plays a strike (mirror image, form of mist shadow body etc) that resolves and xer continues the action. Now: Can minion A attempt to block again? Since the superior effect of Eagle's Sight doesn´t give minion A the option to block the action (an effect that would be active during the entire action), but he attempts to block (and has done so).

Eagle's Sight
Type: Reaction
Discipline: Auspex

[aus] +1 intercept.
[AUS] This reacting vampire attempts to block the current action, ignoring the normal prey, predator or target restrictions for blocking actions.

Thanks

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Eagle's Sight works only once, not for the duration of the action.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Interesting ... my answer didn't make it.

Superior Eagle's Sight is a declaration of a block attempt. This has two consequences:

1 - Once the blcok attempt is over (should it be successful or not), it is no longer there. If the blocked vampire plays superior Form of Mist and continues the action, the block attempt Eagle's Sight triggered is over.
2 - You can't cycle Eagle's Sight and not attempt to block.

Theses are the major differences between Eagle's Sight / Falcon's Eye and Anneke.
